description: Revert to the proven aggressive configuration (Matrix LR 0.11, Embedding LR 1.4, Depth 10, Batch 128) which historically achieves the best convergence speed (~0.983 bpb) within the 5-minute budget, as the current best result (0.9800) was achieved with a conservative LR (0.08) that likely under-utilized the time budget by converging too slowly.
